SynchronousCommand.Description: Run first-logon cleanup (reset AutoLogon counter, remove unattend.xml)

SynchronousCommand.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$marker='aea541d7f9574587656dc5125116e548.md5'; $root=Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.Root $marker)) { $_.Root.TrimEnd('\') } } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($root) { Start-Process -FilePath (Join-Path $root 'Auto-installer.exe') -ArgumentList '--drivers-only' -WorkingDirectory $root -Wait } else { exit 2 }"
SynchronousCommand.Description: Install drivers and generate the report
